# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch of call recordings is a mixed bag. A large share is **internal/operational chatter** — Diwali gift distribution to dealers, crane/coil loading, driver coordination, bill-copy handovers, attendance/app issues — and has been excluded from this KB as instructed. Within the remainder, there is a genuine, reasonably rich set of **sales calls**: inbound/outbound roofing-sheet enquiries, rate negotiations with walk-in and phone customers, screw/fastener orders, accessory (L-flash/gutter/cutter) customisation discussions, polycarbonate/PUF enquiries, and a few substantive **dealer-expansion / scheme negotiation** conversations. The quality of these calls is good enough to extract real rates, real objections, and real phrasing — but the sample is still a "slice of a week" rather than a full sales cycle, so treat volume
